parts.name: pseudostem_banana
sources: The blade of Pisang Awak is 1.13 to 1.90 m by 0.34 to 0.58 m (Sunandar and Kahar, 2017); its leaves droop.
A bunch of about 12.7 hands, 209 fruits and 20 kg; 10 to 14 fruits of 7 to 9 cm on a hand (Sunandar and Kahar, 2017).
The pseudostem of Pisang Awak is 1.8 to 3.75 m (Sunandar and Kahar, Biosaintifika 9, 2017).
6 to 20 leaves in the canopy (Nelson, Ploetz and Kepler, Musa species, Species Profiles for Pacific Island Agroforestry, 2006).
The petiole is more than 30 cm (Flora of China 24); 40 cm is an estimate.
About 22 cm across: a girth of 68 cm at flowering (the Grand Naine, Indian Journal of Agricultural Sciences, 2014).
The blade of Pisang Awak is 0.34 to 0.58 m wide (Sunandar and Kahar, 2017).
